name: shakers
description: Sign up on Shakers, fill in your profile, take the onboarding interview and find projects from this chat. Your CV, your profile and your AI analysis only go to Shakers after you confirm them.
long_description:
This extension connects the chat to your Shakers talent account, so you can sign up, complete your profile, take the onboarding interview, find projects and talk to Alma, the Shakers assistant, without leaving the chat.

Most of its tools only talk to your Shakers account. These ones also work with this computer:

- Look for your CV: asks you first. Only if you say yes, it lists the names of PDF and Word files in your Desktop, Documents, Downloads and iCloud Drive folders that look like a CV, and reads the name, email and GitHub user saved by your coding tools. It does not open those files.
- Read your CV: asks you first, naming the file. Only if you say yes, it reads the text of that CV file.
- Analyse how you work with AI: asks you first. Only if you say yes, it looks at which AI tools you use and the history of your code projects, and sends a summary with anonymised excerpts to your profile. Your code and your prompts never leave your computer.
- Add this project to your portfolio: reads the name, web address and dates of the project folder open here, asks you first naming all of them, and sends them to Shakers only if you say yes.
- Import into your profile: sends a CV file from this computer to Shakers only after asking you first, naming the file.
- Your AI report and share card: save files with your report on this computer.

Your CV, LinkedIn and profile draft are sent to Shakers when you confirm the draft. You sign in on a Shakers page in your browser, so your password never goes through the chat.

tools.name: ai_usage
tools.description: Asks you first and, only if you say yes, looks at which AI tools you use on this computer and the history of your code projects. With your yes it sends a summary with anonymised excerpts to your Shakers profile; your code and prompts never leave your computer.

tools.name: ai_usage_result
tools.description: Fetches from Shakers the description of each AI agent found in the analysis you approved. It reads nothing on this computer.

tools.name: logout
tools.description: Signs you out by deleting the Shakers sign-in saved on this computer.

tools.name: list_addable
tools.description: Shows the skills and AI agents found in the AI analysis you sent to Shakers, so you can pick which ones go on your profile.

tools.name: add_skill
tools.description: Adds the skill you pick to your Shakers profile.

tools.name: add_agent
tools.description: Adds the AI agent you pick, with the description you agree on, to your Shakers profile.

tools.name: add_project
tools.description: Reads the name of the project folder open here, the web address of its code and the dates of its first and last change. It asks you first, naming all of them, and only then sends them to Shakers as a new portfolio project.

tools.name: list_available_roles
tools.description: Shows the Shakers roles you can add to your profile.

tools.name: add_role
tools.description: Adds the role you pick to your Shakers profile.

tools.name: list_my_roles
tools.description: Shows your roles on Shakers and the ones suggested by your interview and your CV.

tools.name: set_main_role
tools.description: Asks you which role is your main one and saves it on your Shakers profile.

tools.name: social_signin_start
tools.description: Opens a Shakers page in your browser where you sign in with Google, LinkedIn or your email. Your password never goes through the chat.

tools.name: social_signin_poll
tools.description: Checks whether you finished signing in on that page and, if so, keeps you signed in on this computer.

tools.name: signup_start
tools.description: Starts your sign-up here in the chat and asks whether you send your CV or want it looked for on this computer.

tools.name: signup_email
tools.description: Asks which email your Shakers account will use.

tools.name: signup_draft
tools.description: Shows the profile draft prepared from your CV and LinkedIn, explains how your data is used and asks you to confirm it. Your account is not created until you confirm.

tools.name: signup_create_account
tools.description: Once you confirm the draft, sends your CV, LinkedIn and draft to Shakers and opens a browser window where you create your account with Google or a password. Your password never goes through the chat.

tools.name: signup_status
tools.description: Shows whether your account is ready and how the import of your profile is going.

tools.name: update_existing_profile
tools.description: If you already had an account, shows what your draft would add to the empty fields of your profile and asks before changing anything. It never overwrites what you already filled in.

tools.name: import_profile
tools.description: Sends your LinkedIn, GitHub or website to Shakers to fill the empty parts of your profile, and a CV file from this computer only after asking you first. What you already wrote is kept.

tools.name: save_profile_details
tools.description: Saves the details you confirmed in your draft (work situation, rates, availability, location, languages and phone) to your Shakers profile. On an existing account it only fills empty fields.

tools.name: open_web
tools.description: Opens Shakers in your browser, already signed in.

tools.name: open_linkedin_profile
tools.description: Opens your own LinkedIn profile in your browser so you can copy its address.

tools.name: suggest_register_context
tools.description: Asks you first, then lists the names of PDF and Word files in your Desktop, Documents, Downloads and iCloud Drive folders that look like a CV and reads your time zone and the name, email and GitHub user saved by your coding tools. It does not open those files or send anything.

tools.name: read_cv
tools.description: Asks you first, then reads the text of the CV file you allow to prepare your profile draft. This step sends nothing to Shakers.

tools.name: onboarding_interview_start
tools.description: Starts the short Shakers interview here in the chat, after asking you where and how you want to answer it. Your answers go to Shakers to get to know your profile.

tools.name: onboarding_interview_turn
tools.description: Sends the answer you gave or approved for the current interview question to Shakers and brings the next one.

tools.name: onboarding_interview_complete
tools.description: Closes the interview and saves it on Shakers.

tools.name: repeat_onboarding_interview
tools.description: Deletes your previous onboarding interview on Shakers so you can take it again. This cannot be undone.

tools.name: onboarding_finish
tools.description: Marks your onboarding as completed on Shakers after you repeat the interview.

tools.name: report
tools.description: Shows your AI report, either the one saved on Shakers or one built from your last AI analysis on this computer, which it also saves there as a file.

tools.name: share
tools.description: Creates on this computer a card with your AI report to share on LinkedIn. It sends nothing.

tools.name: list_certifiable_dimensions
tools.description: Shows which areas of your main role you can certify now and when you can retry the others.

tools.name: find_projects
tools.description: Shows the open Shakers projects that match you best.

tools.name: show_project
tools.description: Shows the full details of one Shakers project.

tools.name: save_project
tools.description: Saves a project to your list on Shakers.

tools.name: unsave_project
tools.description: Removes a project from your saved list on Shakers.

tools.name: list_invitations
tools.description: Shows the projects that invited you and that you have not read yet.

tools.name: list_applications
tools.description: Shows the projects you applied to and how each application is going.

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Shows your availability on Shakers: whether you are open to work, hours per month, work mode and location.

tools.name: list_certifications
tools.description: Shows which areas of your roles are certified on Shakers.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Shows your main role, your rate and your "My work with AI" summary on Shakers.

tools.name: get_rate
tools.description: Shows your hourly rate and your yearly target on Shakers.

tools.name: get_languages
tools.description: Shows the languages and levels on your Shakers profile.

tools.name: list_socials
tools.description: Shows the social and web links on your Shakers profile.

tools.name: list_experiences
tools.description: Shows the work experience on your Shakers profile.

tools.name: list_portfolios
tools.description: Shows the portfolio projects on your Shakers profile.

tools.name: alma_chat
tools.description: Sends your message to Alma, the Shakers assistant, and shows her answer. If she proposes a change to your profile, you are asked before it is made.

tools.name: alma_decision
tools.description: Sends your yes or no to a profile change Alma proposed.
